title: QOL Create modpack
description: A Create-focused modpack with addons, QOL improvements, and a few extra mods.
body:
# QOL Create Modpack

**QOL Create Modpack** is a lightweight, performance-friendly Create-focused pack built for smooth gameplay, clean visuals, and helpful quality-of-life improvements.  
It’s the same pack used on my private SMP, but it works perfectly in singleplayer or on your own servers.

---

## 🔧 Core Focus
This pack is centered around **Create** and its major addons, expanding automation, power, logistics, and building:

- Create Enchantment Industry  
- Create: Steam ’n’ Rails  
- Create: New Age  
- Create Jetpack  
- Create: Power Loader  
- Create: Copycats+  
- Create: High Pressure  
- Create Utilities  
- Create Goggles

---

## 🚀 Performance Boosts
Optimized to keep FPS high even with big factories:

- Sodium + Indium + Reese’s Sodium Options  
- Lithium  
- FerriteCore  
- Krypton  
- ModernFix  
- LazyDFU  
- Dynamic FPS  
- ImmediatelyFast  
- More Culling  
- Entity Culling  
- Memory Leak Fix  

Expect faster loading, smoother chunk updates, and reduced RAM usage.

---

## 🎮 Visual & Gameplay Tweaks
Cleaner visuals, nicer building tools, and UI improvements:

- Iris Shaders  
- MakeUp – UltraFast  
- Continuity  
- Enhanced Block Entities  
- Zoomify  
- Gamma Utils  
- Simple Fog Control  
- Jade + Jade Addons  
- JEI  
- Items Displayed  
- NiftyCarts  

Everything feels smoother and more intuitive without changing the vanilla feel.

---

## 🧭 Exploration & Utility
Extra tools to make survival, multiplayer, and recording easier:

- JourneyMap  
- Traveler's Backpack  
- Immersive Paintings  
- Simple Voice Chat  
- ReplayMod  
- Content Creator Integration  

Great for SMPs, builders, or creators.

---

## 🛠️ Why Use This Pack?
- Great for Create beginners and automation lovers  
- Runs super smooth thanks to performance mods  
- Includes all popular Create addons  
- Works for solo worlds, LAN, or SMPs  
- No bloat — only mods that improve experience

---
